text: The Seifert-van Kampen theorem computes π₁(X) when X = U ∪ V by:
choices: Taking the direct product π₁(U) × π₁(V)
Taking the free product with amalgamation π₁(U) *_{π₁(U∩V)} π₁(V)
Taking the direct sum π₁(U) ⊕ π₁(V)
explanation: van Kampen: π₁(U∪V) ≅ π₁(U) *_{π₁(U∩V)} π₁(V) (when U,V,U∩V are path-connected).
